rust_summary: `NativeBlockEdit.neighbour_updates`: a bulk edit can tell the neighbours of each block it changes, as `set_block` does.
doc_summary: `NativeBlockEdit` has `neighbour_updates` (off by default): when on, `native_edit_blocks` tells the neighbours of each block it changes (`ServerLevel.updateNeighboursOnBlockSet`, so redstone, shapes and the block updates a `set_block` sends follow), as a `set_block` with its flags does; off, no neighbour is told. Bundles need "hooks": @API:edit_blocks_neighbour_updates@.
